status_definitions.SUPPORTED: The narrow public fact is directly evidenced as appearing in an issuer-hosted directory record, or is only the existence of the partner's own published route/policy. Directory-hosted company/solution assertions remain subject to the directory's validation disclaimers and do not imply bid eligibility.
status_definitions.PARTNER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Public partner-authored material supports the claim directionally, but independent issuer/customer verification or direct partner confirmation is still required before proposal reliance.
status_definitions.OWNER_INPUT: The fact requires owner/legal/commercial/confidential-buyer input and must not be inferred from public marketing.
status_definitions.GAP: No adequate public evidence was found, or public sources conflict materially.

items.claim: IBM Partner Plus hosts a directory record that displays BITSUMMIT Corp in Oakville, Ontario as a VAR/Reseller/Solution Provider and displays IBM resale authorizations.
items.limitations: The IBM page states company and solution information is company-provided and not validated by IBM unless noted. This proves only that the IBM-hosted directory record displays these fields; it does not independently authenticate the company facts, resale authorizations, partner relationship, legal identity, financials, Utility Safety eligibility, or Microsoft status. Treat underlying assertions as partner-confirmation-required absent specific issuer evidence.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT's published partner-program privacy policy identifies BITSUMMIT Inc. as an Ontario corporation headquartered in Oakville, with operations in Dallas.
items.limitations: Partner-authored legal statement; government registry evidence was not retrieved. Public naming conflicts with IBM's 'BITSUMMIT Corp'.

items.claim: Public sources conflict on legal suffix and Oakville street address: BITSUMMIT privacy policy uses 'BITSUMMIT Inc.'; IBM directory uses 'BITSUMMIT Corp' at 690 Dorval Drive; BITSUMMIT contact page lists 710 Dorval Drive.
items.limitations: Exact registered legal name, registered office, corporate number, standing, and signing authority require partner/owner evidence before proposal use.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT says it was founded in 2020, is founder-led/private, has 95+ people, and operates delivery teams across Canada and the USA.
items.limitations: Self-published operating-history/headcount claims; not a substitute for bidder-required years-in-business, payroll/headcount evidence, or audited financial history.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publicly names practice leadership including Haseeb Minhas for Cloud, Data & AI and states named senior engineers support engagements.
items.limitations: Useful staffing signal only; project-specific availability, resumes, employment status, location, and commitments require confirmation.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT states it holds the Microsoft Solutions Partner designation for Data & AI (Azure), covering Fabric/Synapse/Power BI, Azure OpenAI, Purview, Azure ML and governed operations.
items.limitations: No BITSUMMIT-specific Microsoft issuing-directory record was retrieved in this audit. Do not represent the designation as independently verified until Microsoft/partner documentation is supplied.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publishes a Data Analytics practice using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks, Synapse, Data Factory, Purview, lakehouse/warehouse patterns, streaming and governed semantic models.
items.limitations: Capability statement, not proof of a particular Utility Safety implementation or committed staffing.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publishes an AI Orchestration practice using Azure OpenAI, AI Search, document intelligence, human-in-the-loop controls, content safety, audit logs and an ISO/IEC 42001-aligned governance framework.
items.limitations: The page says 'aligned to ISO/IEC 42001'; it is not evidence that BITSUMMIT is ISO/IEC 42001 certified.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publishes a 2024 Holt Renfrew case study describing Azure Data Factory/Synapse/Power BI/Azure ML integration across CRM, ERP, POS and e-commerce data.
items.limitations: Named public case study, but no independent customer-side corroboration or reference permission was retrieved. Do not present it as an authorized RFP reference without confirmation.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publishes a 2024 Shell energy/utilities case study describing Azure/AWS license and cloud-procurement optimization with $80,000 annual savings.
items.limitations: Energy-sector relevance is useful, but no Shell-side corroboration/reference permission was retrieved and the engagement is licensing/procurement rather than Utility Safety's exact scope.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publishes a 2025 Destination Canada case study describing Microsoft Copilot readiness, Canadian data-residency/governance controls, workshops and 85% adoption.
items.limitations: Public-sector/Canadian governance signal only; no Destination Canada-side corroboration/reference permission was retrieved.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT publishes a versioned partner-program privacy policy (v1.0, updated 2026-03-18) covering collection, use, retention, security, rights and privacy complaints.
items.limitations: Supports only that a public policy exists and what it states; not a security audit, SOC report, DPA, breach-history statement, or contractual privacy acceptance.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT states it operates 24x7 NOC/SOC services and delivers client environments to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PROTECTED B standards, with written SLAs and named engineers.
items.limitations: This is not evidence that BITSUMMIT itself holds SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification. Exact SLA, audit reports, insurance, incident-response commitments and compliance scope require partner/legal confirmation.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT's current public contact page lists intake@bitsummit.com, +1 833 489 2262, an Oakville office and a Frisco, Texas office.
items.limitations: Route existence only. Existing Muse-cleared outreach is already sent and DNR-unless-reply; this dossier grants zero contact authority.

items.claim: Audited financial statements, revenue, solvency/insurance evidence or bidder-required financial-history evidence for BITSUMMIT.
items.limitations: Public marketing is insufficient; financial evidence specified by the buyer is owner-supplied.

items.claim: Permission and contact details to use named BITSUMMIT customers as formal bid references.
items.limitations: Published case studies do not establish reference consent, current contact details, or buyer-acceptable reference format.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT pricing, subcontract/commercial split, currency, taxes, insurance, SLA, indemnity, IP, acceptance and signature terms for this pursuit.
items.limitations: Must be negotiated/confirmed by the canonical pursuit owner and partner; never infer from public pages.

items.claim: BITSUMMIT's exact eligibility to prime the confidential Utility Safety RFP and buyer acceptance of BITSUMMIT as prime/team member.
items.limitations: Buyer accepted TJLabs' late intent to bid; that does not imply buyer acceptance or qualification of BITSUMMIT. Confidential buyer criteria are outside this public donor.
